figurative_meaning_en: In jest or sarcasm, the behavior of a young girl resembling that of a housewife
example_sentences_in_bangla: ছোট্ট বোনটা সারাদিন ঘর সাজিয়ে গিন্নিপনা করছে।
সে তার বন্ধুদের সামনে গিন্নিপনা করে হাসি তুলল।
example_sentences_in_english: The little sister is playing housewife by arranging the house all day.
She put on airs of being a housewife in front of her friends to get laughs.
note: Refers to traditional gender expectations in Bengali households
